facts.text: The Rome EDITION was conceived, concepted and programmed by entrepreneur Ian Schrager.
facts.excerpt: Conceived, concepted, and programmed by the visionary entrepreneur, Ian Schrager; The Rome EDITION is positioned only a few short steps from Via Veneto

facts.text: The hotel is a few short steps from Via Veneto, Piazza Barberini, the Spanish Steps, the Trevi Fountain and the Borghese Gardens.
facts.excerpt: a few short steps from Via Veneto, the most sought-after street in all of Italy, Piazza Barberini, the Spanish Steps, the Trevi Fountain and the ever-beautiful Borghese Gardens.

facts.text: Many suites have panoramic views of the adjacent church of San Nicola da Tolentino and of Roman streets and roofs.
facts.excerpt: Many offering a panoramic view of the adjacent church of San Nicola da Tolentino and of Roman streets and roofs.

facts.text: The suites have separate living and sleeping areas.
facts.excerpt: feature separate living and sleeping areas.

facts.text: Family options are available upon request.
facts.excerpt: Family options are available upon request.

facts.text: Anima, the hotel's signature restaurant, serves Italian dishes inspired by Rome and Naples, curated by Chef Antonio Gentile.
facts.excerpt: Anima offers an Italian dining experience with bold flavors inspired by Rome and Naples, curated by the Chef Antonio Gentile

facts.text: Anima has a courtyard with over 400 plants.
facts.excerpt: offering an elegant indoor setting and a charming courtyard oasis. With over 400 flourishing plants

facts.text: The Roof is on the seventh floor and has a panoramic terrace and a travertine plunge pool.
facts.excerpt: The Roof, located on the seventh floor, features a spacious dining area with a panoramic terrace and a travertine plunge pool.

facts.text: Punch Room is a speakeasy-inspired bar with amaranth-colored velvet sofas and cocktails that explore the influence of the Roman Empire.
facts.excerpt: recline on the amaranth-colored velvet sofas and explore Punch cocktails that examine the influence of the Roman Empire

facts.text: Jade Bar has green marble interiors and a tasting ritual in collaboration with Le Labo.
facts.excerpt: Jade Bar is an intimate venue with elegant green marble interiors

facts.text: The hotel has a heated rooftop plunge pool open all year round.
facts.excerpt: Heated rooftop plunge pool open all year round

facts.text: The hotel offers 24-hour fitness facilities and 24-hour room service.
Roma Termini train station is about 15 minutes away by car, depending on traffic.
facts.excerpt: A private car to/from Roma Termini (2Km) will take approximately 15 minutes depending on the traffic.

facts.text: Fiumicino airport is about one hour away by car, depending on traffic.
facts.excerpt: A private car to/from Leonardo da Vinci Rome Fiumicino Airport (32Km) will take approximately 1 hour depending on the traffic.

facts.text: The neighbourhood has Gagosian Rome, Galleria Borghese and the National Gallery of Ancient Art in Palazzo Barberini.
facts.excerpt: The National Gallery of Ancient Art is an art museum located in Palazzo Barberini .
